map.📖 查看「护理（等级/评估/计划）制定 使用指南」: View the Nursing Care (Level/Assessment/Plan) Formulation User Guide
map.Barthel 指数 = 进食 + 洗澡 + 修饰 + 穿衣 + 排便控制 +: Barthel index = feeding + bathing + grooming + dressing + bowel control + bladder control + toileting + bed-chair transfer + walking on level ground + stairs, 10 items totalling 0 to 100 points; 80 points or above with normal cognition is level 4 self-care, 60 to 79 is level 3 mild dependence, 40 to 59 is level 2 moderate dependence, below 40 is level 1 severe dependence.
map.老年人护理等级评估（基于Barthel指数ADL+认知+年龄）: Nursing level assessment for older adults (based on the Barthel index ADL plus cognition and age)
map.Barthel指数（日常活动能力，0-100分）: Barthel index (activities of daily living, 0-100 points)
map.需少量帮助 (10分): Needs a small amount of help (10 points)
map.需大量帮助 (5分): Needs a great deal of help (5 points)
map.长期照护等级评定中，用 Barthel 指数（10 项 ADL）结合认知状态划分: In long-term care level rating, the Barthel index (10 ADL items) combined with cognitive status classifies the person from self-care to severe dependence.
map.社区与机构据此匹配巡访频次、照护强度与康复计划。: Communities and institutions use this to match visit frequency, care intensity and rehabilitation plans.
map.评分越高生活越自理；认知下降会叠加依赖等级，需综合判断。: The higher the score the more self-sufficient life is; cognitive decline adds to the dependence level, so a combined judgement is needed.
map.Barthel≥80 且认知正常 → 『四级（自理）』，建议每周探访 1 次、健: Barthel>=80 and cognition normal -> 'Level 4 (self-care)', recommended 1 visit per week plus health guidance and social activities.
map.算例：Barthel=50、认知轻度下降(cog=1): Worked example: Barthel=50, mild cognitive decline(cog=1)
map.Barthel≥40 且 <60 → 『二级（中度依赖）』，需每日探访、协助生活: Barthel>=40 and <60 -> 'Level 2 (moderate dependence)', needs daily visits, help with daily life and rehabilitation training; if cognition>=2, add the cognitive impairment note.
map.Barthel 指数怎么算到 0–100？: How is the Barthel index scored 0-100?
map.10 项 ADL（进食、洗澡、修饰、穿衣、二便控制、如厕、床椅转移、行走、楼梯等: The 10 ADL items (feeding, bathing, grooming, dressing, bowel and bladder control, toileting, bed-chair transfer, walking, stairs, etc.) are scored by degree of independence and summed, for a full score of about 100. The higher the score the more self-sufficient, and it is a dependence scale commonly used at home and abroad.
map.认知状态如何影响等级？: How does cognitive status affect the level?
map.本工具在 Barthel 基础上叠加认知(cog)：高分且认知正常判自理；认知下: This tool overlays cognition (cog) on top of the Barthel: a high score with normal cognition is rated self-care; cognitive decline raises the dependence level and adjusts the care plan (such as stronger anti-wandering measures and medication reminders).
